contentPages.title: Prototype Schedule Note
contentPages.body: This app is currently loaded with prototype attendee programming adapted from the 2025 Not Alone Summit production timeline. It is not final 2026 programming.

contentPages.title: Venue Room Guide
contentPages.body: Margaux is the Wisdom Forum main stage. Lafleur and Pomerol are wellness zones. Mouton 2 is the Nourish Room. Registration is the primary help and wayfinding point.

contentPages.title: Inspiring Children Foundation
contentPages.body: Inspiring Children Foundation supports young people in Las Vegas through programs that connect physical health, emotional wellbeing, academics, athletics, creativity, entrepreneurship, and service.
